about: Three data classes and the only places each may land. Read by
CLASSIFICATION IS A POSITIVE DECLARATION, NOT A SNIFF. Every file written under
output/ or state/ carries an 'ea-class: <class>' line in its first 40 lines, in
whatever comment or frontmatter form the format allows. JSON may carry it as a key:
The named-list sniffer PIPER runs is OFF here (applies_to is empty): the roster is
six managers, so every 1:1 record names one of them by design, and a sniffer that
fires on every legitimate record is a sniffer somebody switches off.

private.definition: Taylor's own private material: personal context, anything the blueprint says must not reach a shared record (s.2).
examples: private notes Taylor asks to keep

records.definition: Named-manager working records: Doc edit proposals and parsed Doc snapshots.
examples: parsed snapshots of a running Doc
records.egress: a proposal reaches a Doc only through WREN running scripts/docs_edit.py

shareable.definition: Copy written to be read by Taylor or sent by him, carrying nothing private.
examples: draft text for Taylor to review (Phase 3 and later)
shareable.egress: Taylor sends it himself; nothing in Phase 1 sends

named_list_sniffer.reason: Off by design for a six-person roster. See about[].
